covariance_whitening: Cholesky factors of the full DESI and Pantheon+SH0ES covariances (lower-triangular solves, never inv(C))
nuisance_projection: analytic SN absolute-magnitude projection P = I - w1 w1^T / ||w1||^2 removing the whitened-ones direction (same as profile_m_analytically)

finite_difference.step_rule: h = rel_step * max(1, |p_j|); column j scaled by param_ranges[j]

note: Fitted coordinates (reconstruction parameters), not measured observables. Never call these five observables.
